failed_or_abandoned: WimPyDD validation integrating only 200-330 keV gave 0.19 of P011's grid at delta = 300 keV: the Xe inelastic window starts near 91 keV (P015); fixed by counting the whole ROI (ratio 1.000).

Quad-based thermal average and Radau ODE inside every root-finding step (200-250 s per block, two runs stopped): replaced by a vectorised trapezoid average on a log u-grid (a linear grid gave 0.66 of the threshold value at x = 1000) and a calibrated semi-analytic freeze-out (ODE retained for validation and benchmarks; agreement 0.97-1.02).
Benchmark auto-mode that rescaled g_N after fixing g_chi left Omega h^2 = 0.13-0.18; replaced by a root-find along the LZ constraint g_chi g_N = G m_Z'^2.
Benchmark B12 (B-L, m_Z' = 1 TeV) converged on the collider-excluded second root (g' = 2.2); the physical branch is B5.
